question: Does the stock game seed its 16-bit Fusion RNG from the phone's wall clock at night load (packages/core/src/mechanics/rng.js, sourced from the decompile), so that a recovered seed minus the low 16 bits of the logged onset time is the same constant K in every run of a session?
whyItMatters: Plan 25 horizons and the 'choose your luck' / precognition paths depend on it: a calibrated K turns every run's logged onset into a ~40-seed window.

established.rngSpace: 65,536 possible nights; k2 wins 65536/65536 in the model at 2416.66, 2433 and 2449.99 ms (docs/evidence/night7-cohort-k2-result-20260914.json, analysis)
established.seedDependenceAt10of20: k2 replayed over seeds 1..3000 at 2433 ms: 2995 distinct event sequences, 2995 distinct video-visible and audio-visible sequences (seed-signatures.mjs) -- the outcome ignores the seed, the events do not
established.hostPhoneWallClock: seed-clock.mjs after cohort r03 (2026-09-14): phone wall clock = host - ~1401 ms, spread 7 ms over 8 samples, 16-20 ms bound per sample (offsetMs = deviceMs - hostMidMs)
established.onsetMarkers: every anchored run logs onsetHostMs and wallMinusHostMs, so the latched onset is known in host wall ms (h1 1789322556522.2, e2 1789318871194.5)

runs: night6-anchoredh1-20260913T180208Z (binding h, won, delivered 4816.10 ms, 37 s0010 blackout-loop onsets)
night6-anchorede2-20260913T170041Z (binding e, died 155.5 s, delivered 4813.98 ms, 7 onsets)
method.onsets: cycle-ledger.py at d29fa6b (the run's own winner timings), encountersFromAudio: audio-census s0010 onsets mapped to night time through the per-cycle s0007 mask-on anchor
method.scan: seed-scan.mjs: for seeds 1..65536, replay the run's winner at its delivered epoch (tools/device/minus-toys-plan.mjs replay, Night 6); an onset is matched when it lies inside a model 'blackout' span [start - 0.5 s, start + 5 s + 0.5 s]; startMatched counts onsets within 0.5 s of a span start
method.test: seed-scan-analyze.py: rank seeds by matched then startMatched; K = (seed - low16(onset host wall ms)) mod 65536; look for h1/e2 top candidates with K within +-30 ms

result.h1: nine seeds tie at 36/37 matched (runner-up also 36) with identical residual lists; start matches peak at 8/37
result.e2: 1687 seeds tie at 6/7; start matches peak at 3/7
result.kAgreement: 0 pairs within +-30 ms among the top 10 x 10 (chance of >= 1 by luck 8.9%)
result.reading: INCONCLUSIVE, not a refutation. The s0010 onsets fall inside the route's own scheduled blackout windows for thousands of seeds, and they are not model blackout starts (residuals 0.3-3.7 s): this observable cannot identify a seed, so K cannot be tested with it.

doNotRepeat: Scoring s0010 blackout-loop onsets against model blackout spans; it is schedule-determined under these routes.
next: an observable that is ROLLED rather than scheduled: Foxy roll witnesses (tools/device/tickphase.py) or exact-roll observations for seed-recovery.mjs filter --mode=rolls
source s0010's trigger from the event dump before using it again (feedback: dump is ground truth)
a run with --bt-audio and a seed-clock sample taken in the same session, outside the Night 7 cohort

nextObservableMeasured.observable: defended office encounters identified through the right eyehole (encounter-corpus-20260912 colour rule; Withered Chica, Bonnie, Freddy)
nextObservableMeasured.modelSide: k2 at 2433 ms over seeds 1..3000 (encounter-lock.mjs): office-cue identities withchica 39577, withbonnie 34566, withfreddy 28741; 30-39 encounters per night (median 34). Largest share of seeds with the same first-N identity+cycle prefix: N=12 31/3000, N=16 9/3000, N=24 2/3000; identity without cycle is much weaker (N=24 14/3000).
nextObservableMeasured.reading: Rolled, non-lethal, frequent and video-visible, unlike the s0010 onsets. With the ~41-seed clock window about ten identified encounters should lock a seed; without it roughly a whole night is needed. The phone ledger marks 13-26 defended cycles per run against ~34 model encounters, so matching must tolerate missed encounters.
nextObservableMeasured.status: model side measured 2026-09-14; phone-side eyehole reader for k2 timing not yet built or validated

seedLockObservables.claimLevel: MODEL_ONLY except the eyehole validation (DEVICE_MEASURED recording, operator labels)
seedLockObservables.binding: k2 at 2433 ms, seeds 1..3000, scaled to 65,536
seedLockObservables.movementModel: Withered, toy and Mangle routes are fixed camera paths (config.js STALLED); WHERE a unit goes is not random, WHEN it steps is: the per-frame cap holds every unit but Foxy (17), Golden Freddy (10) and the Puppet at AI 15, so each movement opportunity succeeds 75% at 10/20.

encounterCut.reading: first encounter ~2 bits, later ones 0.4-0.85 bits; with the clock window ~6 encounters (~84 s) lock; alone it floors at ~22 seeds with identical encounter sequences

movementLock.script: lock-seconds.mjs (wraps Sim.prototype.tick; snapshot each second of every unit's path step, opening and inside flags, Foxy and Puppet loc)
movementLock.reading: a full camera view of where every unit is locks a seed within ~20 s given the clock window, ~30 s at +-100 ms jitter, and nearly alone by 60 s; CAM 11, the only camera k2 watches, cannot

eyeholeReaderValidation.method: corpus crop x175-270 y55-110 at 320x144; mask-on found in the video (top-left 120x40 mean luma < 8), grey camera map skipped; the largest occupant among the first six masked frames (1.2 s at 5 fps) is classified by the corpus colour rule, Bonnie saturation ceiling 0.40 (corpus 0.39; hallfix 110 s reads at the edge)
eyeholeReaderValidation.result: 12/14 operator-labelled encounters correct, 25/25 unlabelled cycles read empty. Misses: 90 s (the corpus notes it was counted from the eyehole with no camdrop witness) and 360 s. The attacker typically fills the eyehole ~1.0 s after mask-on (contact sheet 340-356 s). First attempts that took the window from the corpus prose (flash - 5.6 s) read the camera map: 0/14; the fix was reading the frames.
eyeholeReaderValidation.notYet: not validated on k2 timing or on the Night 6 foxyfix labels

firstFrameClockSeeding.claim: every Fusion frame (scene) load reseeds from (short) System.currentTimeMillis() -- sourced from the decompile, not measured on this phone
firstFrameClockSeeding.whatIsMeasured: the latched first office image in host wall ms (every anchored run) and the host-to-phone wall offset (~-1401 ms, 7 ms spread)
firstFrameClockSeeding.unknown: the gap from the scene load to the first office image and its jitter; each ms of jitter is one more candidate seed
tests: K consistency across the recovered seeds of r01b, r03 and r05 (eyehole encounters over whole nights), host-side

twin nights: two night loads exactly 65,536 ms apart in phone time should replay identical movement and a +30 s control should not; model-free, and it measures the load jitter; needs phone time outside the cohort
